title: Clip
description: One audio clip placed on a track's timeline. Returned by stop_recording (the finished take) and embedded in project.json. All sample units are at the project sample rate.

trackId.description: UUID of the track this clip sits on.

name.description: User-visible clip name (defaults to the source file stem).

sourcePath.description: Audio file path RELATIVE to the .aura project directory, POSIX separators (e.g. "audio/3f2a....wav" or "stems/<clipId>/vocals.wav").

sourceId.description: Decode-cache/asset identity (round-2 §2.2): one sourceId names exactly one sourcePath. Empty string = unassigned (a legacy clip before the load-time fixup mints one deterministically). Additive (D-06); not required so pre-existing writers/readers stay valid.

sourceChannels.description: Channel count of the source file (1 = mono, 2 = stereo).

sourceSampleRate.description: Sample rate of the source FILE in Hz. If it differs from the project rate, the engine resamples on playback.

sourceLengthSamples.description: Total length of the source file, in SOURCE-file samples.

timelineStartSamples.description: Position of the clip's left edge on the timeline, in project samples from project start.

offsetSamples.description: Trim: offset into the source where playback begins, in project samples.

lengthSamples.description: Audible length on the timeline, in project samples.

gainDb.description: Per-clip gain in dB, applied on top of track gain. 0.0 = unity.

fadeInSamples.description: Linear fade-in length at the clip head, in project samples.

fadeOutSamples.description: Linear fade-out length at the clip tail, in project samples.
